title: release params
description: Operator-facing config keys for the release bundle — ADR-0081's locked decision: bundle params validate against JSON Schema. token_env/secret_env are secret NAMES, never values.

name.description: Status context base — statuses post as ci/<name>.

repo.description: owner/name to release; empty releases every watched repo.

cmd.description: Release command run inside the worktree. Default drives tarsi-serve (9aia/tarsi) — the repo's tarsi.toml configures units/publish targets; any shell pipeline still works.

token_env.description: NAME of the secret holding the forge token. Never the value.

timeout.description: Inner shell timeout in seconds (driver cap: 600).
